x-summary: Marital status, number of dependants and an emergency contact.
title: FamilyStatus
description: Marital status, dependents, and an emergency contact —  §1 explicitly calls out family-status changes as one of the life events a person's record should grow to hold. Split out of the generic :status_change escape hatch (which still exists for one-off events that don't warrant a dedicated kind) into a first-class kind, demonstrating the modular-growth mechanism that escape hatch exists to enable.

dependentsCount.description: Count only, not a nested list of dependents — modular-growth story means a dedicated :dependent kind (name/DOB/relationship per person) is a natural, non-breaking follow-up if that level of detail is ever needed; not built ahead of an actual requirement.
